decisive_items: an incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck
T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated a high-signal bend in the same region
response.rationale: R2 directly cites the key raw imaging findings (transverse lateral cortex fracture, no comminution, MRI high-signal bend) and the denosumab history, fully supporting the diagnosis. C1 is an append-only completion of R2 that adds only the denosumab span already present in R2, providing no new raw evidence and relying solely on generator opinion.

rejected.why: Append-only completion with no additional raw support; its sole span is already included in R2, making it redundant.
